verdict.rationale: Marqeta's first-party Core API documents webhooks as notifications about API events, sent as they occur. The platform pushes them to an endpoint hosted in your environment, which is outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence states the core capability but gives little detail on how a subscription is set up or managed. Missing for 10: documented steps for registering or managing webhook subscriptions, an event-type catalog, delivery details (signing, retries), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
